summary_en: 60,000 shares (1.53% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block trade on 2026-08-26 at reference price of ¥3,870/share; total outlay ¥232.2M maximum; order valid for single trading window only; execution results to be published at 08:45 JST.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 25 August 2026, the board of directors of Toba, Inc. resolved to acquire treasury stock via off-hours block trade (ToSTNeT-3). The company will place a buy order on 26 August 2026 at the reference price of ¥3,870 per share during the 08:45 JST ToSTNeT-3 trading window. The acquisition is limited to 60,000 shares (1.53% of issued shares excluding treasury) with a maximum total outlay of ¥232.2 million. The order is valid only for that single trading window; partial or full non-execution is possible if market conditions shift. Results will be published immediately after the 08:45 trading close. The stated rationale is to support flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions and to improve capital efficiency and shareholder value. The company notes no material impact on earnings.
